title: fieldset
description: The fields a project's dataset items may carry (ADR-0003): data/fields/<fieldset_id>.yaml. The harness defines no field; a project declares its own, and any number of datasets can name the same field set. Fields describe items; they are not part of a dataset's identity.

unit.description: for number and integer fields; a duration is always in seconds

values.description: the allowed values of a choice field

required.description: every item must have a value (default false)

public.description: a summary of the values may appear on the static catalog pages (default false)
